name: dddd
author: pcppcp
description: dddd by pcppcp is a noise instrument. All the keys you hold play one shared sound. The lowest key you hold drives it. Each held key also adds a tap to the feedback loop (the four newest count), so a chord changes the texture more than the harmony. Random "hands" keep moving the sound on their own.
credits: From op1r, ported to kennel by Hundekraft
